evidence: Phase 1 actual-WASM controller calls; candidate selection here is controlled policy testing, not live AI

stages.name: bootstrap
stages.state: controlled config-1 seed reconstruction before backup acquisition

stages.name: shortage
stages.state: source_receipts.low after the accepted backup trade and six-unit player purchase

stages.name: after_trade
stages.state: source_receipts.after; root follow-up only, so no new negotiation

workflow: A healthy Rex already owns and lists the crystals; Luna has no initial crystal backup.
Luna independently proposes buying two crystals at four; her gold and inbound space are reserved.
Rex independently approves, reduces his listing to six, then accepts the stored offer.
A player buys the six listed crystals; Rex now has two while Luna owns two backups.
Rex can propose buying those two backups for five each; Luna separately decides whether to accept.
Confirmed settlement conserves gold and crystals. A same-root follow-up cannot start another trade.
Real source replenishment can remove the shortage before a decision completes; revalidate and wait rather than force the trade.
live_preparation: Use ordinary negotiated transfers on a compatible future deployment. Never reseed the public world or assume donors start with free backup goods. Services are owner-started and genuine AI acceptance is a later gate.
